title: TFMG Duststorm
description: Edits to the mod Create: TFMG for the Duststorm modpack that could not be made with a simple datapack.
body:
Crate: The Factory Must Grow has many features that I love and many that I personally do not, this mod serves to change that second category for use in the Duststorm modpack (unreleased) to better fit the vision of the modpack.

Current features list:
- JEI now correctly displays if an industrial blasting recipe requires hot air
- Electrode holders are always operational
- JEI now shows the minimum size required by a vat recipe
- Chemical vat maximum height has been changed to 10 from 3, as it exists in the beta 1.2.2 version of TFMG (not currently present on modrinth?)
